programs.name: Market Value Exclusion

nonVeteran.quote: General homestead market value exclusion under Minn. Stat. 273.13 subd. 35 (not subd. 34); not a veteran benefit

programs.note: Correctly excluded from veteran savings. The '$38,000 for homes <= $95,000' figure in the summary was not re-verified in this pass (subd. 35 not read); it is informational only.

programs.name: Disabled Veterans Homestead Market Value Exclusion

ratingRequired.quote: a service-connected disability of 70 percent or more as certified by the United States Department of Veterans Affairs

tiers.quote: For a disability rating of 70 percent or more, $150,000 of market value is excluded

survivingSpouse.quote: Paragraph (c) carry-over applies only to 'a veteran ... who qualifies for the exclusion under paragraph (b), clause (2)' (the $300,000 tier)

programs.effectiveChanges: No change for TY2026. H.F. 3727 (2026) would have raised the tiers to $225,000 / $450,000 for assessment year 2026; its last action is 'Author added Warwas' (05/12/2026) with no floor vote or chapter, so it did not pass. Senate companions (S.F. 615 $200K/$400K, S.F. 772 $250K/$500K) likewise did not pass. The revisor's current 273.13 history shows no 2024-2026 amendment to subd. 34.
programs.note: Amounts confirmed. Application is due Dec 31 of the first assessment year; exclusion reduces taxes payable the following year.

programs.name: Disabled Veterans Homestead MVE — 100% P&T tier

exemptionValue.quote: for a total (100 percent) and permanent disability, $300,000 of market value is excluded

survivingSpouse.quote: the exclusion shall carry over to the benefit of the veteran's spouse ... until such time as the spouse remarries, or sells, transfers, or otherwise disposes of the property

summary.current: Extends to surviving spouse w/ DIC and primary family caregiver.
summary.correct: Carries over to the surviving spouse who holds title and lives there until remarriage or sale (subd. 34(c)); a spouse receiving DIC or a spouse of a service member who died in service may apply directly (subd. 34(d), (k)); a primary family caregiver may claim it only if the veteran owns no Minnesota homestead (subd. 34(e)).
summary.quote: the primary family caregiver's homestead 'is eligible for the exclusion' that the veteran would otherwise qualify for under paragraph (b)

programs.effectiveChanges: Same as the 70% tier: no 2026 change; the H.F. 3727 increase to $450,000 did not pass.
programs.note: The lead on 'any 2026 change' resolves to no enactment. Re-check after the 2027 session, since the bills had bipartisan co-authors.

summary: The $150,000 (70%+) and $300,000 (100% P&T) exclusions are confirmed in Minn. Stat. 273.13 subd. 34 with no 2024-2026 amendment; the 2026 bills to raise them (H.F. 3727 and Senate companions) did not pass. Rows are structurally right; the P&T row's spouse/caregiver sentence could be tightened, and the 1.12% tax rate sits 0.12 pp above the Tax Foundation 2024 figure.
